description: This bar chart illustrates the performance of different audio-language models on two accuracy metrics, MMAU and MMAR. The horizontal axis represents the model names: Qwen2-Audio-Instruct, Audio-Reasoner, and Qwen-2.5-Omni, listed alphabetically. The vertical axis, labeled “Accuracy (%)”, uses a linear scale ranging from 0 to 70, with tick marks at 10-unit intervals. For each model, there are two bars representing the accuracy for MMAU and MMAR, distinguished by color; MMAU is represented by a light blue bar and MMAR by a purple bar. For Qwen2-Audio-Instruct, the MMAU bar reaches approximately 52% accuracy, while the MMAR bar reaches approximately 28% accuracy. In Audio-Reasoner, the MMAU bar extends to approximately 48% accuracy and the MMAR bar to approximately 14% accuracy. Finally, for Qwen-2.5-Omni, the MMAU bar reaches approximately 64% accuracy and MMAR reaches approximately 49% accuracy. The bars are grouped together for each model, with the MMAU bar positioned to the left and the MMAR bar to the right, and no bars are visually emphasized through shading, bolding, or outlining.
